scope: Initial, manually curated snapshot of reachable browser tabs, GitHub source records and user workspace metadata. This is not a complete Drive, Discord, Colab or cross-platform crawl.

sources.name: Matrixgame collective AI games repository
sources.notes: Repository metadata, README, selected architecture documents, open issues and draft pull requests were inspected. The repository itself describes an evolving research collection, not one finished integrated simulator.

sources.name: Older Java projects repository
sources.notes: README inspected. It identifies the 2021 GravityMaterieSimulator ZIP and demo JAR; binary archives were retrieved as base64 metadata but not extracted or code-audited.

sources.name: GravityMaterieSimulator16122021.zip
sources.notes: The file exists in the public repository and was fetched through the GitHub contents API. Archive contents have not yet been extracted; do not describe its internal classes as inspected.

sources.name: KreisGravitationSim16_12But.jar
sources.notes: The demo JAR exists in the public repository and was fetched through the GitHub contents API. It has not been executed or reverse-engineered.

sources.name: GravityLab3D interactive HTML artifact
sources.notes: Source was inspected from the user's private file library. It contains a 3D Newtonian N-body prototype with Velocity-Verlet, editable bodies, an energy readout and JSON import/export. It explicitly labels orbital geometry as an analogy rather than a physical atomic model. Keep the artifact private until the owner selects a publication route.

sources.name: Evolution Forge and Gravity Cluster research draft
sources.notes: Open draft PR. The 189-run finite parameter grid and package CI were checked in the prior session. Results are descriptive sample outcomes, not universal probabilities; merger is a perfectly inelastic classical proxy.

sources.name: Gaia Earth Lab water-cycle MVP draft
sources.notes: Open draft PR. Contains Java 21 soil and forest water-cycle prototypes, forcing-series and run-manifest classes, and 24 self-tests. Demo forcing is synthetic; the models are not calibrated environmental predictions.

sources.name: LUMINI compiler MVP draft
sources.notes: Open draft PR with a restricted Java 21 parser and dimensional-analysis prototype according to its PR description; two successful CI runs are recorded there. Still separate from main and not yet integrated with the Matrix Core engine.

sources.name: KIM cross-platform knowledge ingestion issue
sources.notes: Open tracking issue for a consent-aware source-ingestion and discussion bridge. Current registry is an initial static inventory, not live synchronization.
